judul: Beyond The Potrait, Into The Ride
deskripsi: The freedom of leaving the familiar behind. The stillness of the portrait gives way to movement, as Mona Lisa steps beyond the frame and into an unexpected journey. The car becomes a symbol of curiosity, freedom, and the desire to experience a world beyond what is already known. For centuries, we have known her as a legend frozen in a single moment, but perhaps there is another side to her story—one that longs to wander, to explore, and to discover places beyond the walls of the portrait. Somewhere beyond the frame, the legendary Mona Lisa may simply be living the life we never knew she wanted: traveling, exploring, and seeing the world for herself.
